meta.title: Usta | Premium Barber Shop
meta.description: Usta Premium Barber Shop offers modern haircuts, beard styling, and professional grooming services.
meta.ogDescription: Modern cuts, beard trims, and premium grooming at Usta.

homeHero.title: Sharp style, confident presence, and care in every detail.
homeHero.subtitle: From classic cuts to modern fades, Usta delivers a complete barbershop experience with expert barbers, precise tools, and warm hospitality.

homeReveal.description: Start with the hero, then reveal each section one by one for a cleaner and smoother experience.

servicesSection.title: Premium services designed for every style
servicesSection.description: Choose your service and let our team shape your look with precision, hygiene, and consistency.

classicCut.name: Classic Haircut
classicCut.description: Clean scissor and clipper work with styling finish for an everyday sharp look.

beardStyling.name: Beard Styling
beardStyling.description: Shape, define, and line up your beard to match your face structure.

skinFade.name: Skin Fade
skinFade.description: High-detail fade blending from skin to top length with clean contours.

fatherSon.name: Father + Son Combo
fatherSon.description: A convenient two-person package with matching quality and comfort.

deluxePackage.name: Deluxe Grooming
deluxePackage.description: Haircut, beard detail, wash, and hot towel refresh in one premium package.

hairColor.name: Hair Color Refresh
hairColor.description: Natural tone adjustment and grey blending with professional products.

extras.popularText: Skin Fade + Beard Styling is our top requested combo for a modern sharp look.
extras.memberText: Join monthly membership to get priority slots and discounted package grooming.

gallerySection.title: Style moments from our daily craft
gallerySection.description: Before and after transformations, interior atmosphere, and real moments from our barbers at work.

extras.noteText: All shots are from our own shop and daily workflow. No stock photos are used in this section.

aboutSection.title: Usta blends classic discipline with modern style
aboutSection.description: We are a team-focused barbershop built around precision service, client trust, and strong grooming culture.
aboutSection.storyText: What started as a local chair has grown into a trusted destination where people come for consistency, comfort, and confidence. Every appointment is treated with care.

precision.title: Precision First
precision.text: Every line, blend, and contour is finished with attention to detail.

hospitality.title: Warm Hospitality
hospitality.text: A friendly environment where every guest feels welcome and respected.

hygiene.title: Strict Hygiene
hygiene.text: Sanitized tools and clean stations are non-negotiable in every session.

craft.title: Continuous Craft
craft.text: Our team improves constantly through training and trend awareness.

jamshid.name: Jamshid
jamshid.bio: Specializes in fades and premium beard shaping.

sardor.name: Sardor
sardor.bio: Known for textured cuts and modern styling finish.

aziz.name: Aziz
aziz.bio: Focuses on complete grooming packages and comfort.

extras.timelineOne: Usta started as a single-chair local barbershop.
extras.timelineTwo: Expanded to a full team and premium grooming packages.
extras.timelineThree: Trusted by thousands of returning clients across the city.

contactSection.title: Book your next visit or send us a message
contactSection.description: Use the form for appointments and questions. We usually respond quickly during working hours.
